queries: WITH p AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS vol FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), s AS (SELECT product_id, vol, vol / (SELECT SUM(vol) FROM p) AS share FROM p), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.vol) AS combined_order_volume, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_share_above_average FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;

assumptions.assumption: Order volume means the sum of Order_Items.product_quantity (a VARCHAR column cast to a number) per product. Total volume is the sum over all order items.
Only products that appear in Order_Items are included when computing the plain average of shares. Products never ordered are excluded.
Shares are fractions between 0 and 1, not percentages, and are not rounded.

alternatives.interpretation: Order volume means the number of order item rows per product, ignoring the quantity values.
alternatives.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS vol FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), s AS (SELECT product_id, vol, vol / (SELECT SUM(vol) FROM p) AS share FROM p), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.vol) AS combined_order_volume, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_share_above_average FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;

assumptions.assumption: Order volume is the sum of product_quantity (a text column, cast to a number) per product in Order_Items. Share is a product's quantity divided by the total quantity across all order items.
The average share is the plain mean over all products that appear in Order_Items. Products with no order items are excluded.
The 'how far above' figure is the mean of (share - average share) across the above-average products, as a fraction and not a percentage.

assumptions.assumption: Order volume is the sum of product_quantity (a VARCHAR, cast to a number) per product_id in Order_Items; share = product quantity / total quantity across all order items. The average share is the plain, unweighted mean across products that appear in Order_Items.
The 'average share' in the output is the mean share of the above-average products only, and the excess is each such product's share minus the overall mean share across all products.
